title: Ingress config-parse CPU incident with parse-once-cache repair

task.summary: Triage an ingress-gateway CPU incident and stop the per-request re-parsing of the routing config.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the CPU hotspot, apply a performance repair, and restore all resolver tests including the parse-count oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the resolver must serve a stream of requests while deserializing the routing-config document a small constant number of times, not once per request.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the ingress-gateway route-resolver workers saturated CPU and blew their p99 latency SLO under steady request volume. CPU time on the resolve path scales linearly with request rate, and the workers spend most of their time rebuilding the same configuration objects over and over.
error_logs: alerts/route_resolver_cpu.log: resolve-path CPU time scales linearly with request rate; throughput collapses under load
profiler: the hottest frame is the JSON decoder (scanner/raw_decode), invoked once per request even though the configuration never changes between requests
reproduction_steps: Inspect the route-resolver fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profiler clues to localize the hotspot before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at repeated deserialization of an unchanging configuration document inside the per-request path, not at the size of the configuration itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic ingress-gateway CPU incident tied to the parse_once_cache fixture.
detection_keywords: CPU saturation on the resolve path
p99 latency regression under steady load
CPU time scales linearly with request rate
localization_keywords: JSON decoder is the hot frame
the same document is deserialized once per request
repeated parsing of an unchanging input inside the request path
redundant work that does not vary between requests
repair_keywords: parse the document once and cache the result
deserialize the configuration a single time and reuse it
hoist the parse out of the per-request path
stop re-parsing the same input on every call
cache the decoded objects across requests
parse once then serve lookups from the cached structure

code_fault.description: The route resolver deserializes the entire routing-config document with json.loads on every resolve call, paying the full parsing cost per request instead of once.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that parses the configuration document once and serves every request from the cached parsed structure.

notes: Combined ingress-gateway config-parse CPU incident and parse-once-cache repair task.
